correspondences.notes: No BIDS counterpart for SNR tables.

brainlife.desc: Experimental CSV of DWI signal-to-noise statistics, e.g. corpus callosum SNR per b0 and gradient direction, or tissue- and shell-specific SNR.
brainlife.name: neuro/snr-stats
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** DWI data-quality checks and comparing acquisitions.

**Not for:** Mixing tables from different Apps without checking columns.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.snr-stats.json

identifying_risks: Rows or file names may carry subject and session codes
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level data-quality measures without direct identifiers; they reveal little about the person.
sharing_cautions: Use coded subject IDs and drop dates
tier_conditions: Tier 1 once reduced to group statistics with no participant rows

intended_use: DWI data-quality checks and comparing acquisitions.
not_suitable_for: Mixing tables from different Apps without checking columns.

outputs_of.name: Compute SNR on Corpus Callosum
outputs_of.purpose: DWI SNR in the corpus callosum
